items.quote: He championed the redesign of the citizen journey for permits and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Quidre headed evidence-based evaluation of programme outcomes, setting priorities for several teams.
Quidre spearheaded the reduction of waiting times at the licensing counter at the national level.
He set the direction for emergency coordination during the flood response across the public service.
He championed steadying a team facing adversity and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
He championed an end-to-end review of the service ecosystem and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
He led the innovation lab's experiments on service design across the department.
He contributed effectively to presentations to senior management.
